pr_title: Rename multiplayer/timeshift namespaces to match their new terms
pr_body:
This may require a couple of passes to catch weird edge cases.

simple ones:
`Timeshift` -> `Playlists`
`realtime` -> ``
`RealtimeMultiplayer` -> `Multiplayer`

a bit more annoying:
`Multiplayer` (the base `abstract` screen) -> `MultiplayerScreen` - should this maybe be `RoomsScreen`?
`MultiplayerTestScene` (the base `abstract` test) -> `RoomTestScene` to avoid conflicts with a second `MultiplayerTestScene`

 I'm also not sure about when we should be including prefixes (when the prefix is already in the namespace):

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/103120593-c3a2ff00-46bb-11eb-98e1-4ca5d4c0add4.png)

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/11291
pr_comments:
Seems like a good start. Follow-up items I'd suggest (in separate pulls, that is):

* Clean up the room vernacular for multiplayer/playlists ("match/room/playlist" and all that)
* Move entire `osu.Game.Screens.Multi` namespace to `osu.Game.Screens.OnlinePlay`, and possibly its most direct descendant classes to match (i.e. `MultiplayerScreen` -> `OnlinePlayScreen`, etc.)

As for the test failures:

* `TestSceneMatchLeaderboard` should inherit `RoomTestScene`, but that test scene is actually entirely broken (uses a local request and data structure instead of `APILeaderboard`, and silences errors, while the underlying API contract changed - and it uses a hardcoded ID anyway, so it really needs to be removed or rewritten entirely).
* Same inheritance error applies to `TestSceneMultiplayerRoomManager`.

I'll push the fixes in a sec.
Let's get this in as a first step. The rest can come in later.

issue_context.title: Clean up in-source naming of multiplayer variants
issue_context.body: Follow-up/continuation of https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/11286, but for the code references.
comments: The proposal is to remove all "Realtime" prefixes (just `Multiplayer` should be fine), and rename all `Timeshift` or `TimeshiftMultiplayer` to `Playlists`.

review_comments:
Would propose renaming the class to `RoomScore` too, along with its derivatives (`IndexedMultiplayerScores`, `MultiplayerScore`, `MultiplayerScores`, `MultiplayerScoresAround`) - or maybe moving to the `Multiplayer` namespace? Not sure but something doesn't fit too well here.

Not to mention that we have an `IndexPlaylistScoresRequest` that returns `IndexedMultiplayerScores`... maybe that should be left as a follow up, then? idk
Not sure what the `Normal` category is supposed to be now - maybe it should be `Playlist`, `SpotlightPlaylist`, `Multiplayer`?
actually you make a good point - we can't change this without extra handling for osu-web api type mapping. will probably need to revert this one back.
